steps.content: She takes a deep breath and steps onto the long-spread red carpet.
Behind the door are clamoring people and countless camera flashes. The girl inhales deeply and pushes open the door...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Wow! Look at the beautiful sea and beach! I've only seen something like that on a set in the studio, never the real thing!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Oh! Could this really be the place where all my wishes come true? Did it hear my wish in the studio?!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You're exactly right!
As Luvia Ray checks out the surroundings, a blue-haired girl walks out of the sea and takes her hands very friendly. Her wet skin and cool palms make Luvia shiver slightly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I know you! How gorgeous you are! I've watched every show you've performed in!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: That's why I arranged a red carpet show for you specifically and brought you to my island. I wanted you to experience the joy of being a superstar...
Luvia's eyes light up instantly.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: So everything just now... It was all prepared by you!
Luvia holds L.L.'s hand and takes her onto the red carpet.
Sure enough, the cheering and shutter noise she heard earlier stir again. Not only that, Luvia Ray can also clearly hear what people are cheering about.

steps.speaker: Cheers
steps.content: The Best Actress! Luvia Ray! A well-deserved academy award winner!

steps.speaker: Cheers
steps.content: I know all of your movies by heart down to each frame! They're so perfect!

steps.speaker: Cheers
steps.content: You're really the best out there!
The crowd's shouts are fervent and insistent. They all stretch out their arms, desperately wanting to touch the dazzling legendary movie star.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ahh... This is truly a scene right out of my dreams!
Surprisingly, upon hearing the praise, Luvia stumbles back a little amid the rising waves of cheers, taking L.L. with her.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I'm not as good as you guys say... I'm, I'm so nervous I'm getting all sweaty...
L.L. props her chin and frowns at Luvia.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But haven't you always wanted to be recognized by the audience... Why aren't you happy now that they're all praising you? Hmm...
Looking at Luvia's genuinely confused expression, an idea crosses L.L.'s mind.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I got it. Think carefully, when you say you want to be "recognized," is there a specific person in your mind?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: This person is the one from whom you most want the approval. You don't care what others think!
Hearing L.L.'s words, the girl falls into pensive silence. After a while, she snaps back to reality and grabs L.L.'s hands firmly.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Exactly! You're absolutely right!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: When the audience praise my acting, of course, I'm really glad, but... there is indeed this one person who I would love to hear compliments from. It'd be more than a dream come true!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Sigh, but I know my acting skills aren't at that level yet... How should I hone my craft? Preferably a normal method, not Mania...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hmm, I got you. Let me see...
Luvia's bright eyes and those tense, whitened fingertips demonstrate to L.L. certain sides of her, which are not captured by the red carpet shows or filming studios.
Intrigued, she licks her lips and looks pensive for a moment. After a while, L.L. claps her hands excitedly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I know! Maybe you can try the mirror method!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Mirror... method?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yes, I hear that a very talented actress used to always practice in front of a mirror and achieved great success. Everyone admired her!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: According to her, once you've practiced enough, you'd feel like the person in the mirror is your other half, like a sister. You can feel her approval through the mirror.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: A reflection of a sister... Are you saying that the mirror can show me Ray?!
Luvia gets all excited and looks longingly at L.L., who grants her wish by conjuring up a luxurious framed mirror with a snap of her fingers.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: We're on Elysiland, where all wishes come true. What you see depends on what you desire! So, act to your heart's content, and you will be rewarded.
She emphasizes the word rewarded with a knowing smile, then leans back and plunges back into the seawater, disappearing.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: "Go away, this damned red mark! Go away! It's so dark here!"

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: "They're laughing at me! I'm sure they're laughing at me!"

The sky gradually darkens, with only the mirror reflecting a dying light. It illuminates the girl making various hysterical and exaggerated movements in front of the mirror, like a spotlight from the abyss.
Even more strangely, the reflection in the mirror behaves completely out of sync with her. "She" simply keeps clapping and smiling, and urges the girl outside the mirror to get closer and closer.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: "How do I look? Am I beautiful? Mirror, answer me!"

Finally, the girl gradually stops moving like a toy running out of battery. Luvia stands in front of the mirror, her breathing unusually shallow. After a moment, she suddenly lunges toward the mirror...
But the expected collision doesn't happen. Her entire head is swallowed by the glass surface, which has turned into water!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Get out! Run!! Leave this cursed place!!!
At the critical moment, the reflection's movement is twisted by an unknown force, turning from a dramatic, unsettling embrace into a desperate push!
The encouraging smile also disappears. The reflection in the mirror, identical to Luvia, seems to break free from its restraints, overcoming the mirror's tension and pushing Luvia out.

With a crisp shattering sound, the strange suction stops all of a sudden. The unknown force also pulls Ray through the mirror, the powerful recoil causing her to fall on top of Luvia, their identical faces pressed together.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray! It's you... It's really you...!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: You saved me again. I can finally touch you. Your hands are so warm!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: ...Yours are warm too.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: No, now is not the time for this! If I hadn't pushed you away just now, you would have completely fallen into the trap! You...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hey, this isn't a trap! It's just a little performance to grant both of your wishes!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Luvia's wish is to gain Ray's approval, and Ray's wish is to protect Luvia... I've just killed two birds with one stone. Pretty impressive, right?
The girl with a body made of vapor appears smugly next to them, seeming to be waiting for her well-deserved compliments with her flushed cheeks.
But what she gets is only Ray's cold response.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: This idiot may believe you, but I won't.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Let's go, Luvia. We can't stay here any longer. With your tiny brain, you'll get eaten alive by this island owner.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hey, are you leaving already? Here, you can touch her and you don't have to fight over the same body and consciousness. Isn't it nice to be free?!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: ...I couldn't care less. I just want Luvia to be safe. This place is far too dangerous for her.
Watching Ray take Luvia away without a second of hesitation, L.L. deactivates the mechanism sustaining Ray's form in frustration. Ray fades gradually, but there's not a hint of regret on her face.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Sigh... You've just got here... You're going to regret leaving so soon!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But... it is indeed enviable that someone is willing to go to such lengths to protect her... Hmph, I've got Manty with me too. Yes, I do. I definitely don't envy them.
